sections.text_helper: Section 25.7.3 "CCB reference tag register (CCB_REFTAGRx)" in chapter 25 (Coupling and chaining bridge (CCB)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 771.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x010 + 0x4 * x (x = 0 to 3)
Reset value: 0x00000000
Writes to this register are ignored when CCB_BUSY is set in the CCB_SR register. The
register is cleared when IPRST is set and CCB_BUSY is cleared.
Bits 31:0 REFTAG{i + 32 * x}: Reference tag bits {i + 32 * x} (i = 31 to 0)
The application must write in these registers, the reference GCM tag of the required
operation blob (respectively ECC signature, ECC key, or RSA key). This enables the PKA
protected operation (respectively ECC signature/public key computation, scalar
multiplication, or modular exponentiation). Refer to Section25.5 for details.
Write to this register is ignored unless OPSTEP = 0x12 in CCB_SR.
